visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, dressed in a professional black suit and tie, stands before a mirror in a well-lit indoor setting. He touches his hair, looking at his reflection with a focused expression. A social media comment overlay appears at the top. (2) The scene shifts to the same man in a white knit sweater with his hair wet. He demonstrates a hair care routine, first showing a white bottle of 'EMULSION'. He applies the product thoroughly to his damp hair, massaging it from the roots to the tips with his hands. (3) He picks up a white hairdryer and begins styling. He uses his fingers to lift and separate sections of his hair, particularly the bangs, while blowing warm air from underneath. He focuses on creating volume at the crown and defining a specific part line. (4) He transitions to a different product, a small black tub labeled 'RETOUCH NEW BALM'. He scoops a small amount of wax, rubs it between his palms, and applies it to his dried hair to add texture and shine. He performs final adjustments to his fringe. (5) The video concludes with the man looking satisfied with his styled hair. He turns his head to show different angles of the hairstyle and gives two thumbs up to the camera with a bright smile.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 每次看到文當的瀏海都覺得整理得好好看... [Slogan]: 今天介紹大家常常訊息問的 33歲日本上班族. (2) [Subtitle]: 我的髮型整理介紹. (3) [Subtitle]: 瀏海長度差不多到鼻頭. [Subtitle]: 首先洗完頭後用毛巾擦乾. [Subtitle]: 把頭髮全部往後弄成All back髮型. (4) [Slogan]: EMULISON護髮乳 常用吹風機、電棒捲、直髮夾等熱傷害修護. [Subtitle]: 接下來用這個商品. [Subtitle]: 均勻塗抹在整頭頭髮上. [Subtitle]: 多用一些讓髮尾也充分塗抹吸收. (5) [Subtitle]: 塗完之後. [Slogan]: 文當習慣5.5:4.5 中分的人較多 想有差異性. [Subtitle]: 清楚的整理出分線. (6) [Slogan]: 用手指抓住想讓頭髮蓬起來的地方 從下往上用吹風機吹. [Subtitle]: 一邊用手指抓住瀏海往後撥一邊用吹風機吹. [Subtitle]: 讓瀏海能夠確實立起來. (7) [Subtitle]: 瀏海吹完後. [Subtitle]: 後腦勺的頭髮就順著髮流吹. [Subtitle]: 像這種感覺. [Subtitle]: 後腦勺就完成了. (8) [Subtitle]: 側面也是從內往外吹乾. [Slogan]: 吹風機順著毛流從前往後吹 這個步驟要特別注意瀏海的立體感. [Subtitle]: 一邊按壓一邊吹整. [Subtitle]: 大致吹整後. [Slogan]: 按壓兩側維持特頭頂蓬鬆度 為了再增加一點蓬鬆感. [Subtitle]: 再細微吹整. (9) [Subtitle]: 造型大致固定後. [Subtitle]: 吹風機部分就結束了. [Subtitle]: 像這種感覺. (10) [Slogan]: RETOUCH NEW BALM MADE IN JAPAN. [Slogan]: 接下來要抹這個髮蠟膏 髮蠟膏比髮蠟更能帶出光澤感. [Subtitle]: 將髮蠟膏均勻地抹在雙手手掌上. [Subtitle]: 以髮尾為中心均勻塗抹在頭髮上. [Subtitle]: 最後再整理瀏海. [Subtitle]: 這樣就完成了. [Subtitle]: 還想知道什麼都歡迎留言給我喔.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a comprehensive hair styling tutorial designed for men. It aims to teach viewers how to style their hair into a specific voluminous, parted look using a hairdryer and specific hair care products (护髮乳 and 髮蠟膏). The narrator provides detailed Japanese instructions with Traditional Chinese subtitles to guide the audience through each step of the routine.
